item.title: Graveyard Keeper 2
item.description:
Title: Graveyard Keeper 2
Genre: Adventure , RPG , Simulation
Developer: Lazy Bear Games
Publisher: tinyBuild
Franchise: Graveyard keeper
Release Date: Sep 22, 2026




About This Game

You are the Grand Inquisitor now! Restore the Town and lead your undead army into battle to save the realm from a zombie apocalypse. Welcome to Graveyard Keeper 2 - the sequel to the original, unhinged classic!

  • Manage your own medieval graveyard

  • Automate your production like never before

  • Lead your zombie army into battle and fortify the Town against the undead

  • Rebuild The Town and milk its residents for maximum profits

  • A world full of unhinged humour, grotesque characters and a twisted story

Build and manage your own medieval graveyard. Harvest as much flora, fauna, and human remains as you can to build extraordinary machinery, automate production, and expand your graveyard for pure profit.

Become the Inquisitor and lead your undead army into battle to save the Kingdom from a zombie apocalypse. Build towers and fortifications, craft powerful armour and weapons, arm and train your not-so-smart troops, and slash your way to victory!

Help the townsfolk restore their homes and turn their problems into revenue. Complete quests throughout the city, as your undead workers take care of the heavy lifting behind the scenes. With zombie-based automation and structured systems, you can transform local efforts into a scalable and profitable operation.

item.title: Nocturne
item.description:
Title: Nocturne
Genre: Adventure , Indie , RPG
Developer: Pracy Studios
Publisher: Pracy Studios
Release Date: Sep 22, 2026




About This Game

A Classic Story RPG

Humanity is gone. Only the Digital Afterlife remains, silent for a thousand years.

Until now.


Nocturne’s rich narrative will leave you questioning what it means to be alive, while you traverse a beautiful world that’s falling apart around you.

  • 100,000+ word story.

  • 101 playable tracks.

  • 10+ hour campaign.

Rhythm Combat for all Skill Levels

Nocturne features an entirely skill based rhythm combat system.
With six difficulty options, Nocturne is suitable for beginners and veterans of the rhythm genre.

Battle a huge variety of enemies and bosses with unique mechanics and unexpected twists.

Time your attacks to land critical hits, but miss too many notes and enemies will attack you back.

Full RPG Mechanics

Nocturne features all the traditional RPG systems, from leveling and stats, to items, equipment, shops, cutscenes, bosses, exploration, and secrets.

Arcade Mode

Beat enemies to unlock them in Arcade Mode, where you can replay any of Nocturne’s 101 original tracks, and go for new highscores.

Live Orchestral Boss Fights

All boss music was recorded live by the Slovak National Symphony Orchestra.

Features

  • Master an entirely skill based rhythm combat system with 101 playable tracks.

  • Meet a cast of unusual characters who'll challenge what it means to be alive.

  • Explore a vast and beautiful pixel art world.

  • Select from six difficulty modes suitable for beginners and veterans of the rhythm genre.

  • Power up from equipment, levels, shops, bosses, exploration, secrets and more.

  • Immerse yourself in an original soundtrack with live orchestral performances.

  • Challenge your highscores in Arcade mode.

  • Befriend a giant orange fish.

item.title: Breakout Garage
item.description:
Title: Breakout Garage
Genre: Indie , Racing , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: Breakout Studio
Publisher: Breakout Studio
Release Date: Sep 22, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 22, 2026




About This Game

Breakout Garage is an open world driving and racing simulator, developed by 2 indie developers, that takes place in Texas, USA. Featuring in depth car building system and various parts combinations for each vehicle making it more suitable for preferred driving style and types of races such as street drag racing, official drag racing, and oval racing.

Current content & features :

  • Simulator physics with toggleable driving aids such as traction control, anti-lock braking system, and electronic stability control to enhance your driving experience based on your preference.

  • Open-world gameplay.

  • Peer-to-Peer multiplayer where you can host/join a server with an in-server race lobby system to challenge other players

  • Highly detailed cars with a wide range of performance and cosmetic customization.

  • First-Person mechanic mode.

  • Part affects physics by weight, aerodynamics, center of mass, engine compression ratio, engine displacement, engine inertia, and much more!

  • Simulated Engine thermodynamics and airflow.

  • In-depth engine tuning with Air-to-fuel ratio and timing that varies based on compression, boost, fuel octane,...and more!

  • Used car dealer where players can choose from an infinite number of randomly generated used cars and inspect them before purchase.

  • Wheel + shifter support.

  • Accurate 1/4 mile and 1/8 mile drag racing with prep/no prep, standard tree or pro tree with leaderboards

  • Simple drift events, time trials, endurance racing with AI racers

  • Realistic economy with realistic prices.

  • Photo-mode for capturing stunning in-game moments and sharing them with friends.

  • Engine swaps.

  • Wear and tear system as parts wear out with use and require repair or change with most parts giving an audible indicator such as lifter tick, rod knock, worn suspension parts,...etc.

  • Simple police & pursuit system with special maneuvers based on wanted level.

  • Restore and sell cars for a profit

  • In depth tire & wheel system to allow 3 types of wheel fitment (stretched, straight, and meaty tires)

  • Paint wear including faded paint, edge rust, and patina.

  • Decal system with interior & window stickers.

  • In-game wiki to help players learn more about game content till real life mechanics.

  • Over 14 real life aftermarket brands

  • Simple delivery job system with random deliveries & payouts depending on load, distance & delivery time.

  • Simple Damage system


Planned features & content :

  • Detailing the map further.

  • A highly diverse career with deliveries, drag racing, drift events, oval racing, and dirt racing.

  • More cars & engines.

  • More customization for each car.

  • Junkyards, more dealers, and more shops.

item.title: Well Dweller
item.description:
Title: Well Dweller
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , RPG
Developer: Kyle Thompson
Publisher: Kyle Thompson , Top Hat Studios, Inc. , Doyoyo Games
Release Date: Sep 22, 2026




About This Game

Deep within the forest, at the bottom of a well, lives the only creature brave enough to kill the queen...

WELL DWELLER is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania made by the creators of Crypt Custodian and Islets!

Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick- who must burn the wicked queen to save his family. Explore a dark fairy-tale landscape and befriend the charming characters who reside in the kingdom’s underbelly. Battle terrifying beasts and gain new abilities to expand your map. Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and unravel the mysteries that lie in this rotted kingdom.

Among the rotting ruins are a charming cast of characters just trying to get by. Go camping with Ilda, a tiny mouse who is on the run from the queens grasp. Explore an abandoned castle with Looter, a mysterious scavenger who searches the kingdom for the best wares to steal. And find and reunite with all of your sheltered siblings who were snatched up one night by a crazed hunter.

Light up your matchstick to illuminate the world and aid in combat. Collect trinkets to upgrade your abilities, and mix-and-match them to customize your game play. Solve puzzles, defeat vicious bosses, and forge your path to the queens quarters to save your family.

item.title: Nighthawks
item.description:
Title: Nighthawks
Genre: Adventure , Indie , RPG
Developer: The Curiosity Engine
Publisher: Wadjet Eye Games
Release Date: Sep 22, 2026




About This Game

Six months ago, you died and were reborn. A vampire. A predator. Not a mere creature of the night, but one of its masters. At least, that’s how things were supposed to be...

Unfortunately, it's a new world out there. Vampires have finally been exposed, and although your existence is more or less tolerated, your ongoing thirst for blood is not. You arrived in the one city willing to promise vampires a fresh start, only to find suspicion and paranoia still lingering on its dark streets. But death could not hold you, and humanity's fear will not hold you back. When the sun sets, outcasts rise . It’s time to seize the night by the throat...

WELCOME TO NIGHTHAWKS

Enter a deliciously twisted new take on vampire role-playing games as you take over a failing nightclub on the wrong side of the tracks, and turn it into your personal empire through seduction, intimidation, and careful use of secret supernatural Gifts. Befriend and recruit fellow outcasts, digging deep into their stories and harnessing their skills. Explore a fully voiced, lavishly written world of dark humour and bright neon as you climb from rags to riches on a mission to master your second life, and prove that even the darkest streets can lead to a brighter tomorrow.

KEY FEATURES

Over 800,000 words of stories and secrets, from the hilarious to the horrific, digging into every corner of a world where vampires no longer own the shadows and both the living and the dead have much to learn.

Build up your nightclub empire to act as a light in the darkness that brings lonely souls together and turns fellow outcasts into found family... or take advantage of your position to feed your own thirst and ambitions.

Ten companions to recruit to your side, including vampire magician Madame Lux, incorrigible con-artist Maze, disgraced private investigator Domino, and Agatha, the free-spirited, perpetual urchin Empress of the Rats.

Powerful vampire magic to use and abuse, including Mesmerism for exerting control over the living, Natural Dominion for making animals do your bidding, and effortlessly shifting into smoke with Tenebrous Form.

Murder, sex, betrayal... even friendship. Everything a modern monster could want.

MEET THE TEAM

Nighthawks is written and designed by Richard Cobbett (Sunless Sea/Sunless Skies) with art by Ben Chandler (Old Skies, Unavowed) , music by Thomas Regin (Unavowed) , and Dave Gilbert (Wadjet Eye Games) as Producer. It was made possible with the generous support of 3,934 Kickstarter backers, and many others who have contributed their faith and assistance. All rats were generously provided by their Empress and paid in delicious berries.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Nighthawks features strong language and adult situations, with occasional moments of non-explicit nudity in romance scenes. Most mature content is only conveyed using text, with no graphic sex scenes or sexual violence.



System Requirements

Windows

MacOS

Linux
